updates.sentence: 3 years imposed. Served time in federal prison. Released in July 1946. Original individual appeal notice in United States v. Masao Mayekawa, District of Wyoming no.4959, dated June 29, 1944 and filed July 1, identifies judgment June 26, 1944, three-year sentence, and confinement in U.S. Marshal custody. Ken House, NARA senior archivist, identifies McNeil Island intake July 10, 1944 from the original intake register. That prison transfer is not treated as the beginning of earlier custody. Sources: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:No._4959_USA_vs_Masao_Mayekawa_-_DPLA_-_4abd5f17ff0547182bdfa1b45a59bd0f_(page_5).jpg ; https://discovernikkei.org/en/journal/2013/6/22/nara-seattle-2/
